# fjordrun_function_token (Data Source)

The token callers of a function send, when its auth is `token`. Needs the member role. Reading it creates it if the environment has none yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "function_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "environment_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_function_token" "hello" {
  function_id    = var.function_id
  environment_id = var.environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `function_id` (String) Function ID.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID. Defaults to the project's default environment.

### Read-Only

- `header` (String) The header that carries it.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token.
